unit.why: A saying of the Seer of Lublin, cited from Mikdash Me'at, that he loves a wicked man who knows he is wicked more than a righteous man who knows he is righteous. The Holy Jew of Przysucha asks why and gets the reason, but the exchange is a teaching with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: One of a numbered series of Lublin sayings (מג, מד, מה); ends with a footnote marker *) whose note is not in this division.
